# Vendored: three.js (screen modes draft, PLAN §20)

Unmodified upstream files from the npm tarball (`npm pack three@0.187.0`, `build/`), loaded directly as ES modules
(no build step). 0.187 ships no minified module build, so the readable files are vendored. `three.module.js` imports
`./three.core.js` from the same folder.
